verdict.rationale: Llama ships as open weights, so the user decides where data lives. The weights can be downloaded (via CLI or Hugging Face) and run on the user's own desktop, edge or mobile hardware. They can also be deployed through major cloud partners such as AWS, Azure and GCP, so data need never leave infrastructure the user picks. missing for 10: no explicit first-party documentation framing this as data residency or region selection, region choice on cloud partners is only implied, and no independent hands-on corroboration of residency control.
